differences.native: MySQL computes each visit gap with DATEDIFF.
differences.app: SQLite subtracts the two julianday values and casts the maximum whole-day gap to INTEGER.
differences.rationale: SQLite does not implement MySQL's DATEDIFF function. The LEAD window, 2021-01-01 terminal boundary, per-user maximum, grouping, aliases, and unordered result semantics otherwise match.
